info.title: kontur-ofd-mock — Контур.ОФД read/reconciliation
info.description: Public documentation as of 2026-10-11. Read-only fiscal data; no receipt writing or callbacks. [FORK] offset canonical; provider test schema unavailable. Credentials env-only or generated owned sandbox. Synthetic fixtures, UTC inclusive periods and error messages are mock-local. Amounts: integer kopeks. Sid TTL default 2592000 seconds on virtual clock. No Cookie auth support.

servers.description: Single mock for auth + data; remote base via env

schema.description: Password, UTF-8 plaintext. NOT JSON, NOT form-urlencoded.
